articles.title: kstmostofa/laravel-whatsapp
articles.summary: The article describes a technical software development project focused on integrating WhatsApp functionalities into web applications built with Laravel. It details a dual-backend approach using Meta Cloud API and `whatsapp-web.js` for comprehensive personal account access, managed via a Livewire admin interface. This system aims to provide developers with a robust and user-friendly solution for seamless WhatsApp communication within their platforms.

articles.title: Experts warn Africa risks becoming mere raw data supplier
articles.summary: African technology, finance, and infrastructure leaders warn the continent risks being a mere raw input supplier in the global AI economy. They emphasize Africa must urgently develop indigenous AI capabilities and intellectual property. This strategic shift is crucial to avoid dependency, secure a competitive, value-added role, and foster economic growth and technological sovereignty.

articles.summary: Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will undertake a state visit to Japan starting May 26th. This visit aims to strengthen the close bilateral ties between the two nations, especially given their significant relationship concerning crude oil supply. articles.title: News24 | 4 dead, 100 injured as Russia hits Ukraine with hundreds of drones and hypersonic missile
articles.summary: Russia launched fresh attacks on Kyiv and surrounding areas, resulting in four fatalities and extensive damage to residential buildings and several schools, as confirmed by Ukrainian authorities. European leaders have strongly condemned these strikes, underscoring the severe humanitarian impact and international diplomatic fallout of the ongoing conflict.

articles.title: Pilgrims kick off hajj as war's trajectory hangs in the balance
articles.summary: Muslim pilgrims engaged in evening prayers around the Kaaba, Islam's holiest site in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, on May 24, 2026. This pivotal ritual occurred during the annual Hajj pilgrimage, a significant global religious event attracting millions of devotees worldwide. The gathering highlights a major international spiritual observance and Saudi Arabia's role as host.

articles.title: Pilgrims kick off hajj as war's trajectory hangs in the balance
articles.summary: Over 1.5 million Muslims have commenced the annual Hajj pilgrimage in Mecca, Saudi Arabia, filling a vast tent city. This spiritual journey for millions unfolds against a global backdrop of hopes for an end to ongoing international conflicts, lending a poignant dimension to the sacred rituals. Pilgrims engage in prayers and rites, embodying unity and devotion.
